symptoms.title: Warm air from vents
symptoms.description: The unit runs and the fan spins, but the air at the vent never turns cold — usually low gas pressure, a weak capacitor, or choked coils.

symptoms.title: Cooling fades by afternoon
symptoms.description: The room feels fine at 8 am but the AC cannot hold against a 40°C Chennai afternoon, a sign the system is losing capacity, not just fighting the heat.

symptoms.title: Ice on the copper pipes
symptoms.description: Frost on the lines or the indoor coil points to a refrigerant leak or blocked airflow, and running the unit further can damage the compressor.

symptoms.title: Compressor trips repeatedly
symptoms.description: The outdoor unit starts, strains, and cuts out within minutes — often a failing capacitor or the voltage fluctuations common across Chennai.

symptoms.title: Set to 24°C, stuck at 30°C
symptoms.description: Hours of running without reaching the set temperature means a fault somewhere in the cooling circuit, and a faulty thermostat sensor is a frequent culprit.

symptoms.title: Higher bills, weaker cooling
symptoms.description: A struggling AC draws more power to deliver less cold, so a rising electricity bill is often the first measurable symptom.

faqs.question: My AC is running but not cooling. What is usually wrong?
faqs.answer: In Chennai homes the usual causes are clogged filters, dirty condenser coils, low gas pressure, or a weak capacitor. Less often it is the thermostat sensor or the compressor itself. Our six-point diagnosis works through each in sequence, so we identify the actual fault rather than the most convenient one.

faqs.question: What does the ₹299 visit charge cover?
faqs.answer: It covers the full diagnostic visit: the six-point inspection, gas pressure readings, and a written quote for the fix. If you approve the repair, the charge is waived entirely. You only pay it if you decide not to proceed.

faqs.question: Can you fix it in one visit?
faqs.answer: In most cases, yes. Our technicians carry common capacitors, sensors, and refrigerant, so faults like a failed capacitor or low gas are resolved on the spot. Compressor and PCB failures may need a part ordered, in which case you get the quote and timeline before we leave.

faqs.question: Is poor cooling always a gas problem?
faqs.answer: No, and this is where many services overcharge. Choked filters, dirty coils, and a weakening capacitor all mimic gas loss. We test the actual gas pressure and show you the reading before recommending any top-up, which starts from ₹1,499 only when genuinely needed.

faqs.question: Why does my AC lose cooling faster in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Coastal humidity and sea air corrode condenser coils, monsoon damp stresses electricals, and voltage fluctuations shorten capacitor life. All three quietly eat into cooling capacity over a season. That is why our diagnosis checks the electrical side alongside gas and airflow on every call.
